Manpower is looking for part-time and full-time logistic workers for various companies in the Eindhoven area. Together with you, we will find the employer that suits you best. Thanks to the extensive network that manpower has in the region, we can find an employer that meets your needs. Your working activities always have something to do with logistics, such as:    - Loading and unloading trucks    - Placing articles in racks    - Picking orders and preparing the orders for shipmentWhat’s in it for you    - Gross salary from €14.99 till € 16,00 per hour    - Reimbursement of travel expenses    - Shift allowance (amount depends on the client)    - Part-time or full-time position between 32 and 40 hours per week    - Possibility to earn a contract with the client    - Free access to the online learning platform Manpower Academy    - A valid forklift and/or reach truck certificate    - Availability of at least 32 hours per week    - Good command of the Dutch or English language in order to understand work and safety instructions    - Preferably some working experience in logistics, for example as an order picker, warehouse employee, logistics worker or similarDo you meet all requirements? Apply today!
